##### Project general facts

Jouri Hills at Jumeirah Golf Estates is an exclusive residential enclave offering a collection of 294 contemporary homes, ranging from elegant three-bedroom townhouses to expansive six-bedroom mansions. Surrounded by lush landscaped parks, the community is designed to promote a serene and active lifestyle, blending modern architecture with natural greenery in one of Dubai’s most prestigious golf destinations.

Each home is thoughtfully designed to maximize natural light and spatial openness, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, skylights, and double-height interiors that create a bright and airy atmosphere. Smart home technology is integrated throughout, enhancing convenience and modern living. Detached villas come with private swimming pools as standard, while the most luxurious residences span over 14,000 square feet across four levels, including basements, underground parking, flexible entertainment or fitness spaces, and beautifully designed English courtyards for private outdoor gatherings.

The homes are finished with high-quality contemporary materials that emphasize lightness and comfort. Kitchens are fully equipped with premium European appliances, including a dishwasher, washing machine/dryer, oven, hood, microwave, and refrigerator. Properties are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to tailor interiors to their personal style within this refined, nature-integrated community.

##### Location description and benefits 

Jumeirah Golf Estates is an exclusive and opulent residential and leisure development nestled in the southwestern part of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. This luxurious community is renowned for its world-class golf facilities and opulent living spaces, making it a coveted destination for both golf aficionados and those seeking a high-end lifestyle.

The heart of Jumeirah Golf Estates is its two splendid championship golf courses, meticulously designed by golf legends Greg Norman and Pete Dye. These courses, named the Earth Course and the Fire Course, are nothing short of masterpieces. Among them, the Earth Course stands out as the host of the prestigious DP World Tour Championship, an illustrious event on the European Tour, drawing top-tier professional golfers from around the world.

Beyond the golfing allure and lavish homes, Jumeirah Golf Estates boasts a wealth of community amenities and facilities. These include recreational spaces, fitness centers, and fine dining options, providing residents with a well-rounded and enjoyable lifestyle.
